=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11317-11338 (same-head guard 11219-11221; caller 29845-29862) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In `maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion`, when `set_tracking_phase_label` fails, the handler restores the parked state with the PR head added to `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas`, saves it again and returns failure; that head's one automatic retry is spent although no merge retry or validation dispatch ran.
  WHY: The same-head guard then skips the SHA as `already_resumed_on_head` on every later tick, so a transient label-write failure leaves the project failed and blocked until the PR head changes or a person steps in, which goes against issue #9320 items 4 and 5 ("skip the retry for that tick"). Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna rate it MAJOR; sonnet rates it NIT because it is not a regression from base behaviour and is a deliberate trade-off that stops state writes on every tick; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash (narration, no entry) calls it "a deliberate, documented trade-off … not a defect". The highest rating, MAJOR, is used here as high.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11120-11121, 11272-11275 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The header comment ("Every other outcome prints exactly one skip line and returns 1 with the state untouched (fail closed).") and the write-order comment ("a failed persist or label write restores the saved state so the project stays parked unchanged.") both say the state is left untouched, but the label-failure branch at 11320-11338 now writes the head into `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` and saves the state again.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but an operator or later editor who trusts the comments would expect a retry on the same head after a label-write failure, when the next tick actually logs `already_resumed_on_head`. All reviewers rate it NIT (low).
- agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The fragment sentence "Any failed lookup skips with the state unchanged" is wrong for the label-write failure, which is logged as reason=lookup_failed detail=label_write and keeps the head in the ledger.
  WHY: This is a documentation-only contradiction of the code (NIT). minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash describe the fragment as already updated or corrected in the last run, so the reviewers disagree on this point.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Stop after one try per head SHA. Record each final-PR head SHA that has had an automatic retry." (Issue #9320 item 4)
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhaustion
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer wrote this in TASK_GAP shape, but its own evidence ends: "The implementation fulfills the 'stop after one try' requirement, so no gap." It says the ledger update to `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` and the save are performed when the label write fails, and that the "one try" logic is enforced through the persistent ledger (SEVERITY: NIT). The other reviewers reported no task gaps.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:about lines 11320-11338 (label-failure branch after "if ! set_tracking_phase_label "${fmar_phase_label}"; then"); ledger guard about line 11219 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed label write uses up the head's one automatic retry even though no merge retry and no validation dispatch ran, which goes against issue #9320 item 5 ("skip the retry for that tick and log why"). `set_issue_phase_label` (line 4507) does a single gh_retry gh issue edit, and it also fails before any write when resolve-phase fails or the label contract is missing.
  WHY: If the edit still fails after gh_retry runs out, the project stays failed and blocked on a green, clean head until the PR head changes or a person steps in. That matches the shubhodeep1/fun-token-multi-chain#596 incident, limited to this double-failure case. It is not a regression and is a deliberate trade-off; an optional alternative is a separate per-head counter for label-failure attempts.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11120-11121, 11272-11275; agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md:2 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The header comment ("state untouched"), the write-order comment ("stays parked unchanged") and the fragment sentence "Any failed lookup skips with the state unchanged" contradict the label-failure branch, which now writes the head into `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas` and saves the state again.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but readers who trust these lines would expect a retry on the same head; the next tick actually logs already_resumed_on_head. The fix is a 3-line rewording.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The reviewer matched issue #9320 items 1-6, the FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME log prefix, the changelog fragment and the tests to changes in the diff. It confirmed that the harness kwargs fail_issue_edit_for and fail_issue_comment_post_for exist (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py lines 871 and 875).
- HARDENING: reword the comments at 11120-11121 and 11272-11275 and the agents.d sentence (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:function-header comment immediately above `local fmar_failure_kind=""` and write-order comment immediately above `fmar_state_backup="${STATE_FILE}.fmar.bak"` | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both comments ("state untouched" / "stays parked unchanged") describe the behaviour from before the last run and contradict the label-failure branch and the updated `agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md` fragment.
  WHY: There is no runtime impact, but readers would expect a retry on the same head after a label-write failure; the SHA guard actually skips it as `already_resumed_on_head`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~11318-11338 (jq restore block), guard ~11219-11220; agents.d/8984-final-merge-auto-resume.md | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `set_tracking_phase_label` fails, the function restores the parked state with the head added to `final_merge_auto_resume_head_shas`, saves it again and returns failure; the guard then skips that head on every later tick.
  WHY: A transient label-write failure (API hiccup, a temporarily missing `label_contract.v1.json`, a 5xx on `gh issue edit`, a permissions gap) spends the one retry before any merge or validation runs. This goes against #9320 item 4 ("each final-PR head SHA that has had an automatic retry") and item 5 ("skip the retry for that tick"). The trade-off is defensible because of the earlier loop bug. The suggested alternative is a separate infrastructure-failure ledger or flag, with `test_final_merge_auto_resume_label_failure_parks_and_spends_head` re-pointed at it.
- HARDENING: reword the function-header and write-order comments to describe the label-failure branch (~3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
